functions.abi: int ipc_service_register_endpoint(const struct device *instance, struct ipc_ept *ept, const struct ipc_ept_cfg *cfg)
functions.evidence: Pinned Zephyr ipc_service.c at v3.4.99-ncs1-1, compiled by the retained CPUNET build with CONFIG_IPC_SERVICE=y, deferred logging, and CONFIG_IPC_SERVICE_LOG_LEVEL=3, emits the firmware's complete 0x64-byte body. After normalizing its two R_ARM_THM_CALL and three R_ARM_ABS32 relocations, every byte matches: the three argument guards, -EINVAL log path, instance->api and register_endpoint guards, -EIO log path, ept->instance publication, token address increment, and backend tail call. The normal Zephyr archive exports this public symbol; the strong retain-all collision identifies the selected object but is not used as the match proof.
